notes: CG is supplied as measured loaded mass-centre coordinates.
Actual CAD surface is used at a fixed calculated equilibrium draft. No proxy hull or empirical drag is substituted.
This fixed-hull case measures towing resistance and total fluid force at a prescribed pose; it cannot calculate free roll or stability response.
Laminar flow is an explicit baseline for small, untripped models. Transition, roughness and near-wall resolution require sensitivity checks or measurements.
Water-air surface tension is enabled with a 90-degree implicit wetting assumption. Real printed-material contact angle is unknown.
The initial domain is a starting proposal only. Side/bottom slip boundaries and outlet can still affect results; numerical domain independence has not been established.
Coarse mesh is a solver smoke test, not an accuracy certificate. Actual achieved refinement, hull/waterline resolution and refinement convergence must be checked.
For a printed hull, a separate closed displacement envelope sets the initial cavity phase to air. This envelope is not included in the meshed physical hull.
No boundary layers are added by this starter case. Finite-volume wall stress and pressure drag require near-wall mesh convergence.
Regular Stokes-I waves at zero current only. This is not the original irregular Bretschneider sea, even when a numeric Hs preset is reused as regular height H.
Native waveVelocity does not add a towing current. Nonzero-speed advancing-wave cases are rejected rather than silently changing the requested physics.
Native shallow-water active absorption is an initial boundary treatment, not a guarantee of negligible reflection in this domain. Measure reflection using empty-tank gauges and vary boundaries.

Graded wave background: 276000 cells; 6 vertical cells per height and 30.5854598596 cells per wavelength before hull refinement. These requested resolutions are starting levels for a global wave propagation convergence study; no achieved-wave validation is implied.

The complete mass inertia tensor is estimated from CAD and stated payload assumptions, not measured. The only free rotation uses effective axial inertia a^T I a about the longitudinal hull axis; other rotation components are constraint reactions.

Only heave +Z and rotation about the initial longitudinal hull axis (0.939372712847 0 -0.342897807455) are free; all other translations and rotations are constrained. No empirical roll damping is imposed: viscous/capillary forces are solved by interFoam. Morphing mesh may fail at large heel and must be quality-checked throughout.
Force-object moment reference remains the initial CG. sixDoF internally uses its moving centre of rotation; distinguish those references when post-processing moments.

inertiaAssumptions: Prescribed synthetic full mass inertia tensor, used solely to test native reduced-DOF constraint/orientation handling.
motion.inertiaProjection: effective inertia a^T I a for the only free rotation
